name: Canva
write_up: Canva turns photos of your work into polished social posts and stories, with AI tools to write captions and resize them. There's a free plan, so you can try it before paying anything. We've listed it for salons and cafés; check Canva's own site for current paid prices.
why: Free tier, and the only tool in the first batch listed for more than one trade (Salons and Cafés).
